purpose: Bounded reproducible teaching data/model assets; owner implements all application runtime and UI.
output: assets/operations/data/{id}.json, one self-contained lazy-loaded case payload

records.input: model input (flat for cnn/mlp, TxF for gru)
records.baseline: numeric/vector reference method if computed offline
records.display: case-specific plotted arrays, timestamps, features, source geometry

validation.boundary: sample scope; do not force improvement

parity.expected: raw network or solver output before UI parameters; computed independently in Python

gru.weightIH: flat 3H x I; PyTorch r,z,n order
gru.note: single layer, batch_first, zero hidden; no dropout at inference

otherModels: Document exact formula/schema beside script. Runtime owner can adapt. Store all coefficients, normalization, and independently computed parity checks. Do not edit core.js, shared content.js, lessons.js, stage.js, package, shell, index or other agent case files.
quality: No fabricated chronology, labels, scope or validation.
Group related records before splitting; fit all scalers on training only.
Use real CSV units; never silently relabel them.
Preserve failed/low-score candidates and feasible constraints.
Small CPU models; no huge dataset in initial page download.
All exported JSON finite, UTF-8 LF, round to sensible precision (typically 7 digits).
Keep raw research files unmodified; no deletes.
